name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.7 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 9 visits over 67 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.8 days starting 2025-05-26, at wavelengths from 1.12 to 4.74 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
